alternative: The original six-channel heuristic union (ranker retrained on it)
decision: Retrieval design: learned full-catalog retriever + long-tail floor + interest
experiment: Recall and Gate-B rows of each candidate set on the corrected features, plus end-to-end fixed-denominator NDCG@10 with the ranker retrained on each set (eval/decomposition.py).
metric: candidate recall / lift over chance; end-to-end NDCG@10
verdict: Learned retriever: recall 0.926 (long-tail 0.898, lift +0.374); legacy union: recall 0.596 (long-tail 0.540, lift +0.203). The legacy union wins end-to-end NDCG@10 (0.1919 vs 0.1814, paired p=0.0047) with a ranker retrained on each set. The retriever ships (it is the one that meets the recall and long-tail gate rows); switching on a holdout comparison would be selection leakage.
